# JoharTrip

> Pilgrimages, journeys & travel guides across India. Free travel and pilgrimage guides for India: how to reach, best months, things to do, permits and rules, and village homestays. Updated 2026-11-10.

Contact: contact@johartrip.com

## Pilgrimage routes

- [Char Dham Yatra (All-India)](https://johartrip.com/pilgrimages/char-dham/): The four sacred abodes established by Adi Shankaracharya at the four corners of India.
- [Chota Char Dham (Uttarakhand)](https://johartrip.com/pilgrimages/chota-char-dham/): Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath in the Garhwal Himalaya.
- [12 Jyotirlinga Yatra](https://johartrip.com/pilgrimages/12-jyotirlingas/): The twelve self-manifested shrines of Lord Shiva across India.
- [Shakti Peetha Darshan](https://johartrip.com/pilgrimages/shakti-peethas/): Powerful shrines of the Goddess where parts of Sati are believed to have fallen.
- [Ganga Yatra: Rishikesh to Varanasi](https://johartrip.com/pilgrimages/ganga-yatra/): Follow the holy Ganga from the Himalayan foothills to the eternal city.
- [Ram Circuit](https://johartrip.com/pilgrimages/ram-circuit/): Places linked to Lord Rama, from Ayodhya to Rameswaram.

## Destination guides

- [Alleppey Backwaters, Kerala](https://johartrip.com/destinations/alleppey-backwaters/): Alappuzha (Alleppey) is the gateway to Kerala's backwaters: a network of lagoons, canals and lakes lined with coconut palms. November to February is dry and cool, and houseboat season is in full swing. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Andaman Islands, Andaman and Nicobar Islands](https://johartrip.com/destinations/andaman-islands/): The Andamans are one of India's best islands for diving, snorkelling and beaches. The dry season runs from about November to April, with calm seas and the easiest ferries. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Auli, Uttarakhand](https://johartrip.com/destinations/auli/): Auli is a ski resort above Joshimath, with meadows, oak forests and views of Nanda Devi. Snow usually arrives from late December and stays into March. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/ayodhya/): Ayodhya, one of the seven holy cities, is home to the grand Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir, Hanuman Garhi and the illuminated Ram ki Paidi ghats. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Badrinath, Uttarakhand](https://johartrip.com/destinations/badrinath/): Badrinath, on the banks of the Alaknanda, is one of the original Char Dham and the Chota Char Dham, with hot springs, colourful temple architecture and Mana, India's 'first village'. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Coorg (Kodagu), Karnataka](https://johartrip.com/destinations/coorg/): Coorg is a hilly district in the Western Ghats, known for coffee estates, waterfalls, Kodava culture and cool weather. Winter is dry, green and fragrant with coffee harvest. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Darjeeling, West Bengal](https://johartrip.com/destinations/darjeeling/): Darjeeling offers sunrise over Kanchenjunga from Tiger Hill, the UNESCO-listed toy train, world-famous tea gardens and Buddhist monasteries. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Dooars homestays, West Bengal](https://johartrip.com/destinations/dooars-homestays/): Homestays across the Dooars, from tea-estate villages to forest-edge hamlets near Jaldapara and Gorumara, offer a lowland, wildlife-oriented alternative to the hills. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Dwarka, Gujarat](https://johartrip.com/destinations/dwarka/): Dwarka, the western dham, is home to the Dwarkadhish temple, the Nageshwar Jyotirlinga nearby and Bet Dwarka island, now reached by the Sudarshan Setu bridge. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Goa, Goa](https://johartrip.com/destinations/goa/): Goa is India's favourite beach state, with Portuguese-era churches, spice farms, quiet Hindu temples like Mangueshi and Shantadurga, and a relaxed coastal lifestyle. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Gokarna, Karnataka](https://johartrip.com/destinations/gokarna/): Gokarna is a small coastal town in Karnataka with a string of beaches reached by short cliff walks. It is quieter than Goa and works well from November to February. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Gulmarg, Jammu and Kashmir](https://johartrip.com/destinations/gulmarg/): Gulmarg, a high meadow in Kashmir, becomes a snow playground from about December to March. A two-stage gondola takes visitors close to 4,000 m for skiing and mountain views. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Hampi, Karnataka](https://johartrip.com/destinations/hampi/): Hampi is a UNESCO World Heritage site, the ruined capital of the Vijayanagara Empire. Temples, bazaars and royal enclosures are scattered across a landscape of giant boulders and banana fields. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Hanle and Changthang homestays, Ladakh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/hanle-changthang-homestays/): Hanle and the Changthang plateau in eastern Ladakh offer homestays and astro-stays near the Indian Astronomical Observatory, with Tso Moriri, Kiang herds and nomad culture nearby. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Haridwar, Uttarakhand](https://johartrip.com/destinations/haridwar/): Haridwar is one of the seven holy cities and a Kumbh Mela site, famous for the evening Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri and as the starting point of the Char Dham yatra. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Hornbill Festival, Kohima, Nagaland](https://johartrip.com/destinations/hornbill-festival-kohima/): The Hornbill Festival is held every year from 1 to 10 December at the Naga Heritage Village in Kisama, near Kohima. It brings Naga tribes together for dances, music, food and crafts. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Jaipur, Rajasthan](https://johartrip.com/destinations/jaipur/): Jaipur, a UNESCO World Heritage City, offers Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, the City Palace, Jantar Mantar and the revered Govind Dev Ji temple. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Jaisalmer, Rajasthan](https://johartrip.com/destinations/jaisalmer/): Jaisalmer is a sandstone town in the Thar Desert, with a living fort, carved havelis and dunes where visitors camp under the stars. Winter nights are cold, but days are pleasant, which makes November to February the best window. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Jibhi and Tirthan Valley homestays, Himachal Pradesh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/jibhi-tirthan-homestays/): Jibhi and the Tirthan Valley, near the Great Himalayan National Park, are known for wooden homestays, river walks, waterfalls and quiet village life in the Banjar region of Kullu district. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Kamakhya (Guwahati), Assam](https://johartrip.com/destinations/kamakhya/): Kamakhya temple on Nilachal hill in Guwahati is one of the most important Shakti Peethas and the centre of Tantric worship, famous for the Ambubachi Mela. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Kaziranga National Park, Assam](https://johartrip.com/destinations/kaziranga/): Kaziranga is a UNESCO World Heritage site and home to the world's largest population of one-horned rhinos. The park opens for the dry season in about November and runs until April. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Kedarnath, Uttarakhand](https://johartrip.com/destinations/kedarnath/): Kedarnath, highest of the twelve Jyotirlingas, sits beneath snow peaks at the head of the Mandakini valley and is reached by a mountain trek from Gaurikund. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Kinnaur homestays: Sangla, Chitkul and Kalpa, Himachal Pradesh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/kinnaur-homestays/): Sangla, Chitkul and Kalpa in Kinnaur offer homestays among apple orchards, wooden temples and views of the Kinner Kailash range. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Kolkata, West Bengal](https://johartrip.com/destinations/kolkata/): Kolkata pairs the Kalighat Shakti Peetha, Dakshineswar and Belur Math with colonial heritage, legendary food and UNESCO-listed Durga Puja. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Lava, Kolakham and Rishyap homestays, West Bengal](https://johartrip.com/destinations/lava-kolakham-homestays/): A cluster of quiet hill villages in the Kalimpong district where homestays run by local families are the main way to stay, with forest walks, sunrise views and home-cooked Himalayan food. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Manali, Himachal Pradesh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/manali/): Manali is a busy hill town in the Beas valley, with snow in winter, old temples and adventure sports. December and January bring snow to Solang and nearby slopes, and New Year crowds. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Markha Valley trek homestays, Ladakh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/markha-valley-homestays/): The Markha Valley trek near Leh lets trekkers stay in village homestays along the route, eating with local families and crossing high passes with views of the Stok Kangri range. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Meghalaya (Shillong and Cherrapunji), Meghalaya](https://johartrip.com/destinations/meghalaya/): Meghalaya has waterfalls, caves, living root bridges, crystal-clear rivers and Khasi hills culture. Autumn and winter are the best seasons. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Munnar, Kerala](https://johartrip.com/destinations/munnar/): Munnar is a high-range tea town in the Western Ghats, with rolling plantations, waterfalls and cool, misty mornings. Winter is a cold, clear season and one of the best for views. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Nubra Valley and Turtuk homestays, Ladakh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/nubra-valley-homestays/): Nubra Valley villages such as Hunder, Diskit, Sumur and Turtuk offer homestays among apricot orchards, with monasteries, sand dunes and a distinct Balti culture at Turtuk. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Parvati Valley homestays: Kasol, Tosh and Kalga, Himachal Pradesh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/parvati-valley-homestays/): The Parvati Valley villages of Kasol, Tosh, Kalga and Pulga offer homestays, guesthouses and hostels with river views, forests and treks to places like Kheerganga. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Pondicherry, Puducherry](https://johartrip.com/destinations/pondicherry/): Pondicherry (Puducherry) is a former French colony on the Coromandel Coast. Yellow colonial houses, bougainvillea, cafes, a long seafront promenade and the township of Auroville make it a relaxed winter break. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Puri, Odisha](https://johartrip.com/destinations/puri/): Puri, one of the Char Dham, is home to the Jagannath temple, the Rath Yatra chariot festival and a long golden beach on the Bay of Bengal. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu](https://johartrip.com/destinations/rameswaram/): Rameswaram, on Pamban island, is both a Char Dham and a Jyotirlinga, famous for its 22 sacred wells, the longest temple corridors in India and the ghost town of Dhanushkodi. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Rann of Kutch, Gujarat](https://johartrip.com/destinations/rann-of-kutch/): The Great Rann of Kutch is a vast seasonal salt flat near the Pakistan border. After the monsoon water dries up it turns into a blinding white plain, and the Rann Utsav tent city at Dhordo brings crafts, folk music and camel rides to the edge of it each winter. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Ranthambore National Park, Rajasthan](https://johartrip.com/destinations/ranthambore/): Ranthambore is one of India's best-known tiger reserves, set around a 10th-century hill fort and ancient lakes. The cooler months from October to April are the best time for safaris. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Rishikesh, Uttarakhand](https://johartrip.com/destinations/rishikesh/): Rishikesh combines ashrams and Ganga Aarti with river rafting and mountain cafes, and is the gateway to Neelkanth Mahadev and the Himalayan pilgrimages. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Sham Valley homestays: Alchi, Likir and Ule, Ladakh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/sham-valley-homestays/): The Sham Valley west of Leh has low-altitude villages and monasteries such as Alchi and Likir with homestays that suit acclimatisation and short village-to-village treks. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Sandakphu and Singalila trail stays, West Bengal](https://johartrip.com/destinations/singalila-sandakphu-homestays/): The Singalila ridge trek to Sandakphu uses village homestays and simple trekkers' lodges at Maneybhanjan, Tumling, Kalipokhri and Sandakphu, with Himalayan views including Kanchenjunga. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Sittong homestays, West Bengal](https://johartrip.com/destinations/sittong-homestays/): A low-altitude hill village in the Darjeeling district with family-run homestays, orange orchards and views of the Kanchenjunga range, popular as a quieter alternative to Darjeeling. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Somnath, Gujarat](https://johartrip.com/destinations/somnath/): Somnath, traditionally the first of the twelve Jyotirlingas, stands on the Arabian Sea coast at Prabhas Patan, with an evening light-and-sound show and the Triveni Sangam nearby. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Spiti Valley homestays, Himachal Pradesh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/spiti-valley-homestays/): Spiti's high-altitude villages such as Kaza, Kibber, Langza, Komic and Dhankar offer homestays where Spitian families host travellers in traditional houses, with monasteries and star-filled skies. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Sundarbans, West Bengal](https://johartrip.com/destinations/sundarbans/): The Sundarbans is the world's largest mangrove forest, a UNESCO site shared with Bangladesh, where rivers meet the Bay of Bengal. Boat safaris go through winding creeks in search of tigers, crocodiles and birds. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Tirupati & Tirumala, Andhra Pradesh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/tirupati/): The Sri Venkateswara temple at Tirumala is among the most visited shrines in the world, famous for its darshan system, hair-offering tradition and laddu prasadam. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Udaipur, Rajasthan](https://johartrip.com/destinations/udaipur/): Udaipur is Rajasthan's most romantic city, with white palaces reflected in Lake Pichola, narrow bazaars, craft markets and hill forts nearby. Winter, from November to March, is the best time. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/ujjain/): Ujjain is home to the south-facing Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga, its unique dawn Bhasma Aarti and the Mahakal Lok corridor, and hosts the Simhastha Kumbh on the Shipra. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Vaishno Devi (Katra), Jammu & Kashmir](https://johartrip.com/destinations/vaishno-devi/): The holy cave of Mata Vaishno Devi on the Trikuta mountains is reached by a well-paved trek of about 12-13 km from Katra, with ponies, battery cars and helicopters for help. (last checked 2026-11-09)
- [Varanasi (Kashi), Uttar Pradesh](https://johartrip.com/destinations/varanasi/): One of the oldest living cities on earth, Varanasi is home to the Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga, the evening Ganga Aarti and more than eighty ghats along the holy river. (last checked 2026-11-09)
